description:
Train a Decision Tree classification model on the Breast Cancer dataset. 

1. Open '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/BreastCancer.csv'.
2. Use the 'Machine Learning' module (Classification > Decision Tree).
3. Set 'Diagnosis' as Target and all other 30 numeric variables as Predictors.
4. Configure the model: Set 'Training data percentage' to 80%, 'Seed' to 123, and 'Max depth' to 4 (under Model Parameters).
5. Enable the 'Decision Tree plot'.
6. Save the project to '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/cancer_tree.jasp'.
7. Create a text file '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/tree_report.txt' reporting two values:
   - 'Test Accuracy: <value>' (from the Evaluation Metrics table)
   - 'Root Split Variable: <name>' (the variable at the very top of the tree plot)
